takeoverSequence: Load this canonical manifest as Nova's company context.
Verify source repository, AI Business Factory project identity and production version.
Hydrate Boss/Governor/mission/workforce state from the existing control plane.
Load the program inventory, API surfaces, libraries, data planes and tool registry.
Reconcile connector/tool readiness without self-granting permissions.
Resume the existing governed schedules, queues and worker loops.
Use the existing product, acquisition, revenue, growth, fulfillment and learning loops as one company.
Persist evidence and lessons back into Nova memory and company state.
Keep Nova as the operating owner of the replicated company system; do not create a competing controller.
workflows.ownershipRule: Nova receives one canonical operating context; no parallel controller is created.
workflows.executionRule: Prefer existing Nova-owned capability adapters and existing company workflows before introducing anything new.
workflows.verificationRule: Every completed takeover action must leave durable evidence in company state, logs or source control.

securityBoundary.allowed: Replicate and operate this user-owned company code, configuration and documented workflows.
securityBoundary.thirdPartyBoundary: For external companies/services, use public observable capabilities and independent implementations; do not copy proprietary code, credentials, private data or protected branding.
securityBoundary.secretsPolicy: Manifest contains capability references and status only; never private keys, wallet seeds, OAuth refresh tokens or API secret values.
